from kinematics import fk
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
LOW=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['lower']);HIGH=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['upper'])
BASE=np.array([0,.8,0.])
def ik(T,qseed):
    def err(q):
        F=fk(q,BASE)[0]
        return np.r_[(F[:3,3]-T[:3,3])*5,Rot.from_matrix(T[:3,:3].T@F[:3,:3]).as_rotvec(),.005*(q-qseed)]
    sol=least_squares(err,qseed,bounds=(LOW[:7]+.001,HIGH[:7]-.001),max_nfev=200,ftol=1e-10,xtol=1e-10,gtol=1e-10)
    if np.linalg.norm(err(sol.x)[:6])>.03: print('IK residual',err(sol.x))
    return sol.x

def settled_move(q,seconds=1.5,name='move'):
    o=move(q,seconds,name+'_ramp')
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,seconds=.5,include_depth=True);o.save(str(ROOT/name))
    with (ROOT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(dict(name=name,q=np.asarray(q).tolist(),seconds=seconds,settle=.5))+'\n')
    return o

def shift(delta,name,seconds=2,rot=None):
    o=observe('latest');q=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][58:87]);qreal=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);F=fk(qreal,BASE)[0];F[:3,3]+=delta
    if rot is not None:F[:3,:3]=rot@F[:3,:3]
    q[:7]=ik(F,qreal)
    return settled_move(q,seconds,name)
